newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to drift to 4,830 after firm start.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to drift to 4,830 after firm start.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may weaken towards 4,830 after attempting to go up to around 4,860 on Monday, technical analysts said.
Leading stock prices had started to fall away late last week and despite a positive start this morning they may come under pressure as the day wears on.

Having failed to regain the 4,900 level last week there should be little investor enthusiasm to attempt any meaningful stock market revival so that leading shares will then be allowed to drift lower, analysts said.
By 0735 GMT, the FTSE was up 6.0 at 4,857.5.
The market has been making lower intra-day highs over the past three days and has failed to stay above its 10- day moving average -- which is now at 4,879 -- implying short-term weakness.

Its unsettled nature will allow it to move within a 45-point range today but the action of the past week has created a downward channel which is falling at an average rate of 17 points a day -- and this will force the market lower.
"The trend for further unsettled and deteriorating share prices is likely to continue (short-term)," said one analyst.
